atoms.b: Metamorphic rocks are formed when other ((++rocks animals)) are affected by extreme pressure and heat.
The types of conditions that create metamorphic rocks can be found ((++deep shallow)) in the Earth’s crust, or where ((++tectonic_plates national_borders)) meet.
Metamorphic rocks can only be formed if the rocks involved ((++do_not_melt melt)).
If there is too much pressure and heat, the rocks will turn into ((++magma water)) and will eventually become ((++igneous_rocks sedimentary_rocks)) instead.
The outside layer of the Earth is called the ((core ++crust)).
This layer is made up of ((++tectonic_plates mountains)), which are constantly ((++moving stationary)).
The movements of tectonic plates change the ((++landscape animals)) of the Earth.
The types of conditions that create metamorphic rocks can be found where ((++tectonic_plates rocks)) meet.
The UK sits in the middle of a tectonic plate called the ((++Eurasian_Plate Pacific_Plate)).
